basic_profile.bio: Hi, I'm Alex, a tech enthusiast from Toronto, Canada, diving into the world of crypto trading. I recently graduated with a degree in Computer Science and have a budding interest in algorithmic trading. When I'm not exploring crypto markets, I'm usually building and managing Minecraft servers or binge-watching 'Victorious'. I work as a junior software developer during the day and tend to browse Reddit in the evenings. I'm single and enjoy connecting with fellow techies online.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid foundation in programming from my Computer Science degree. I've been teaching myself about cryptocurrencies and trading through online courses and forums. My interest in technology extends to managing game servers and exploring new software tools.
